_note: Source of truth for every page. The completed trips are the club’s own; the planned expeditions (006, 007) are plans: their routes, group sizes, costs and itineraries are illustrative until the board confirms them. Rebuild with site/tools/build_pages.py.

expeditions.name: Paradiset
expeditions.terrain: Huddinge’s largest continuous forest: pine and spruce, mires and small lakes, with Sörmlandsleden running through it
expeditions.note: The club’s first trip: a day hike in Paradiset, the largest continuous forest in Huddinge, south of the city. Pine and spruce, mires and small lakes, and a stretch of Sörmlandsleden.

expeditions.name: Bogesundslandet
expeditions.terrain: Mixed and broadleaf forest, old farmland and long shorelines on Stora Värtan, with Bogesund Castle
expeditions.note: A day hike on Bogesundslandet in Vaxholm, north-east of the city: mixed forest, open farmland and long shorelines, past Bogesund Castle.

expeditions.name: Tyresta
expeditions.terrain: Old pine forest, granite ridges, the area burnt in 1999, boardwalks over bogs
expeditions.note: A day hike through Tyresta National Park, south-east of Stockholm: old pine forest, granite ridges and quiet lakes.

gallery: Single file through the spruce forest.

expeditions.name: Lovö
expeditions.terrain: Oak woods, old pastures, fields and shoreline on Lovön in Lake Mälaren, by Drottningholm Palace
expeditions.note: A day hike on Lovön, the island of Drottningholm Palace in Lake Mälaren: oak woods, old pastures and shoreline in the Lovö nature reserve.

expeditions.name: Kungsängen
expeditions.note: A day hike at Kungsängen in Upplands-Bro, north-west of Stockholm.

expeditions.name: Abisko
expeditions.terrain: Birch forest, the Abisko canyon, open fell, the Njullá ridge
expeditions.transport: Night train from Stockholm Central to Abisko Turiststation, about 17 hours
expeditions.climate: Autumn and early winter: below zero at night, the first snow on the mountains, northern lights on clear nights
expeditions.cost: Train, huts and food at cost, listed when registration closes
expeditions.leaders: Two club trip leaders; a certified guide for the Njullá ridge
expeditions.note: The club’s first expedition north, in planning: three days in Abisko National Park, with birch forest, the Abisko valley and the Njullá ridge. Members hear first when the dates are set.

itinerary.title: Up the Abisko valley
itinerary.text: We arrive on the morning train, walk through the Abisko canyon and follow Kungsleden along the river to the Abiskojaure mountain hut.

itinerary.title: Across the open fell
itinerary.text: We leave the marked trail and cross the open fell above the tree line. We stay in a hut or in tents, depending on the conditions.

itinerary.title: Njullá and the journey home
itinerary.text: With a certified guide we climb the Njullá ridge (1,169 m), then walk down to Abisko for the evening train to Stockholm.

packing: Hat, buff, two pairs of gloves
Map and compass, the club brings the rest

gallery: Lapporten from the frozen shore of Torneträsk, midwinter.

expeditions.name: Sarek
expeditions.terrain: No marked trails or huts: frozen valleys and mountain passes on skis
expeditions.transport: Night train to Gällivare, bus to Kvikkjokk, then on ski
expeditions.climate: March: −20 to −2 °C, long light, storms that last days
expeditions.leaders: Two certified mountain leaders; ski touring experience required
expeditions.note: A planned week-long ski tour through Sarek National Park in late winter, with tents and pulks. For members who have joined a winter trip with the club first.

activities.name: Hiking
activities.text: Day hikes in the nature reserves around Stockholm, such as Tyresta, Paradiset, Bogesundslandet and Lovö, most of them reachable by public transport. Regular trips through the year.

activities.name: Mountaineering
activities.equipment: Boots, crampons and ice axe where needed
activities.text: Trips to the Swedish mountains above the tree line: long days on foot, summits, and in winter crampons and ice axe. Planned with experienced members and, where the route needs it, certified guides.

activities.name: Winter
activities.text: Snowshoeing, ski touring and walks on frozen lakes during the winter months.

activities.name: Expeditions
activities.text: Multi-day trips to the Swedish mountains, travelling by night train and staying in mountain huts or tents. The first, to Abisko, is in planning.
